scripts.fetch-types: mkdir -p types && curl ${MANAGE_HOST:-https://manage.softagen.com}/engine/types/v0.1.0/aiwebengine.d.ts -o types/aiwebengine.d.ts && echo '✓ Type definitions updated'
scripts.fetch-openapi: mkdir -p apis && curl ${MANAGE_HOST:-https://manage.softagen.com}/engine/openapi.json -o apis/openapi.json && echo '✓ OpenAPI description downloaded to apis/openapi.json'
scripts.fetch-graphql-schema: mkdir -p schemas && node scripts/fetch-graphql-schema.js && echo '✓ GraphQL schema downloaded to schemas/schema.json'
scripts.outdated: npm outdated || echo '✓ Checked for outdated packages'
scripts.format: prettier --write --log-level warn "**/*.js" "**/*.ts" "**/*.json" "**/*.md" && echo '✓ JavaScript files formatted'
scripts.format-check: prettier --check "**/*.js" "**/*.ts" "**/*.json" "**/*.md" && echo '✓ Source files match Prettier formatting'
scripts.lint: markdownlint "**/*.md" --ignore node_modules && echo '✓ Markdown files linted'
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:ts && npm run typecheck:js && echo '✓ TypeScript and JavaScript type checks passed'
scripts.verify: npm run format-check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.all: npm run fetch-types && npm run fetch-openapi && npm run fetch-graphql-schema && npm run format
